summary_en: mbs authorized acquisition of up to 200,000 shares (2.89% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of ¥3.0 billion through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from December 7, 2026 through November 30, 2027 to improve capital efficiency.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On November 16, 2026, mbs, inc.'s board of directors authorized the acquisition of treasury shares. The company will repurchase up to 200,000 shares of its ordinary stock, representing 2.89% of the 6,931,854 shares outstanding (excluding treasury shares), at a maximum cost of ¥3.0 billion. This implies a ceiling price of ¥15,000 per share.

The buyback will be executed through open market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from December 7, 2026 through November 30, 2027. The company stated that the acquisition is intended to improve capital efficiency and to execute flexible capital policy in response to changing business conditions.
